title: Retain detached launcher worker failure diagnostics in its run artifacts
outcome: Retain detached launcher worker failure diagnostics in its run artifacts
acceptance: Detached _run failures preserve actionable diagnostics for execution.lock refusal and unexpected exceptions in saved artifacts, while ordinary completion output remains metadata-only and a duplicate executor never overwrites the admitted owner's results.
Regression coverage demonstrates both the duplicate-admission failure and an unexpected worker exception without diagnostic prose entering normal stdout or notification bodies.
disposal_reason: Fable ruling e07a4663: share the same launcher implementation file and one changeset; preserve both original criteria verbatim in the replacement bundle.
